stories.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel as Iran-US clashes escalate
stories.summary: Crude oil climbed to a seven-week high above $100 a barrel after the US destroyed five Iranian tankers and Tehran retaliated, stoking fresh supply fears around the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: US military says it destroyed 5 Iranian oil tankers after missile attacks on Navy warship
stories.summary: The US destroyed five Iranian oil tankers in response to missile attacks on a US Navy warship, and Tehran retaliated against American targets in Jordan — sharply escalating fighting in the Gulf.

stories.title: Google to invest $15B in AI datacenters and buy nuclear power in Finland
stories.summary: Alphabet's Google will invest at least €13 billion (about $15.1 billion) in AI infrastructure in Finland over two years — its largest single investment in Europe — and signed its first nuclear power contract outside the US.

stories.title: Anthropic researcher believes more than 10% chance AI 'could kill all humans'
stories.summary: A senior Anthropic researcher said there is more than a 10% probability that advanced AI could destroy humanity, reigniting debate over existential AI risk.

stories.title: Suno launches v6 AI-music models with licensed music, will pay royalties
stories.summary: Suno released its v6 AI-music models, the first built with licensed partners Warner, BMG and Believe, is paying royalties and retiring all previous models as it transitions away from its contested training data.

stories.title: Browns news: buzz growing around a pair of rookies
stories.summary: Cleveland's daily news roundup highlights growing buzz around the Browns' rookie class — including a pair generating early attention — as the team wraps up preparation for Sunday's opener in Jacksonville.

stories.title: Jaguars vs Browns predictions, picks, odds for NFL Week 1
stories.summary: USA TODAY's NFL experts made their picks for the Browns' season opener, with Deshaun Watson facing heavy pressure in his first regular-season start since 2024 behind a revamped offensive line.

stories.title: Jeremiah Smith eyes a breakthrough vs. Texas as No. 1 Ohio State faces No. 4 Longhorns
stories.summary: Star wide receiver Jeremiah Smith is looking for a breakout performance as top-ranked Ohio State visits No. 4 Texas in Saturday's marquee college football showdown in Austin.

stories.title: Ohio State lands top tight end in the 2028 recruiting class
stories.summary: Ohio State secured a commitment from a top tight end prospect in the 2028 recruiting class, adding recruiting momentum ahead of Saturday's top-five matchup at Texas.

stories.title: Spanish Grand Prix: everything you need to know about F1's brand-new Madring
stories.summary: A guide to the new Madring street circuit in Madrid, which debuts this weekend as the home of the Spanish Grand Prix, replacing Barcelona-Catalunya.

stories.title: FIA makes key Madring decision, confirming two active aero zones for Spanish GP
stories.summary: The FIA confirmed two active aero zones for this weekend's Spanish Grand Prix at the new Madring circuit, a decision that will help shape the season's first race at the debut venue.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov 1.1.5.0 patch notes released
stories.summary: Battlestate Games released the full notes for patch 1.1.5.0, a major update in Escape from Tarkov's current 'Kord Breach' season, adding a host of fixes and content.

stories.title: Central Ohio cities debate Flock camera usage
stories.summary: Columbus-area cities are debating whether to keep Flock automatic license-plate-reader cameras as the city reviews the program amid privacy concerns from residents.

stories.title: One killed in South Side Columbus shooting
stories.summary: A person was found shot to death in an alley on Columbus's South Side, the latest in a string of shootings across the city this week.

stories.title: US Marshals find 79 missing children in Ohio's largest such operation
stories.summary: A monthlong US Marshals operation called 'Operation Meridian' recovered 79 missing or endangered children across Ohio — the largest missing-child sweep in state history.
